requirements.text: Place the ESP32-C3 module inside the housing

rounds.summary: The ESP32-C3 module is currently positioned outside the housing to the right, failing the interior placement and 1 mm enclosure clearance requirements. The housing and button remain unchanged. A repair moves the ESP32-C3 module inside the housing above the left side of the carrier board with more than 1 mm clearance from the enclosure interior.

observations.detail: The ESP32-C3 module is located outside the housing at X = 68 mm rather than inside the enclosure.
The measured enclosure clearance check fails with a -41.6 mm margin against the required 1 mm interior clearance because the ESP32-C3 module lies outside the housing walls.
The housing preserves its original geometry and position at [0, 0, 0] with size [70, 26, 50] mm.
The button remains unchanged in geometry and placement at [22, 12, 24] mm.

checks.detail: Component IDs, graph references, motion bounds and source geometry passed deterministic validation.
Procedural envelope metadata agrees with the actual solid bounds within 2% or 0.5 mm; source CAD dimensions are preserved.
Fit tolerances, forces, electrical compatibility, wiring, firmware and physical operation remain unverified.
Minimum envelope-to-interior margin -41.6 mm; required 1 mm. Interior from the actual box floor and four wall faces. Component envelopes are conservative; physical tolerances are unverified.
